headline: Bank of Japan Releases Data on Bond Holdings and Accepted Collateral
summary: The Bank of Japan published updated figures on Japanese government bonds held by the central bank alongside details on accepted collateral as of the end of October.
why: The Bank of Japan is Japan's central bank, managing monetary policy and holding a significant portion of Japanese government debt.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: The Bank of Japan releases official central bank financial balance and collateral figures.
